thread:
Alex: Heads-up — NordicHealth RFP: must keep data and metadata inside EU/NO, BYO-KMS in customer account, and no US subprocessors for telemetry. They also want firm fallback policy: if EU capacity exhausted, requests must be rejected (no soft-fail to US). Can SE/ops/legal confirm feasibility and rough pilot cost? cc @Priya @Tom

Priya (acct): They specified Norway (eu-north-1) as preferred, will accept eu-west-1 as secondary. BYO-KMS required. Auditor prefers VPC peering; will accept static egress IPs only if backed by attestation.

Tom (ops): Feasible for a scoped POC: tenant pin to eu-north-1 (or eu-west-1), disable telemetry/tracing for the tenant, wire BYO-KMS connector to their key in their account, and enforce routing policy with failure_mode: reject. Cloudflare edges in EU OK if edge logging disabled. Hosted control plane still in us-central though — for POC we can route control signals through an EU-resident proxy and ensure no telemetry leaves EU; but legal caveat applies.

Hana (legal): Legal: cannot represent Hosted as EU-control-plane. We can provide a time-limited technical attestation describing mitigations (tenant pin, telemetry off, BYO-KMS, EU proxy) for the pilot. For contractual guarantees require Dedicated/Private with EU control-plane and approved subprocessor roster.

Alex: Okay. Can ops list which subprocessors would still see metadata in the POC if we apply mitigations? Customer flagged any telemetry to US subprocessors as deal-breaker.

Tom: With mitigations: payload stays in customer-chosen EU region (eu-north-1/eu-west-1). Telemetry/tracing disabled; analytics disabled. Remaining subprocessors that would normally see metadata (GCP logging, Datadog, Sentry) will be opted-out. The only residual flow would be our control-plane orchestration signals, which we will proxy through EU for the POC and not retain logs. We'll include that in attestation.

Priya: Pilot sizing: they want a 14-day pilot, 100 reqs/hr, avg 150 tokens. Need 14-day pilot price and also a rough Dedicated EU-control-plane prod number.

Tom: Ballpark pilot ops: one-time setup $1k (peering/proxy + BYO-KMS test) + $600 pilot ops; Dedicated EU-control-plane estimate starts around $10k+/mo. If they insist on guaranteed control-plane locality in contract, quote will shift to Dedicated pricing and provisioning lead times (2-4 weeks).

Alex: SE action: produce 1-page runbook + routing config snippet (include failure_mode: reject) and example attest wording. Priya to send attestation + pilot quote if legal signs off.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-11011 created: "NordicHealth EU/NO POC - BYO-KMS + EU-proxy + reject-fallback" assigned to Tom.

Hana: I'll draft a short attestation stating the scoped mitigations and time-limited nature; will not substitute for contractual control-plane residency.

Alex: Thanks team — keep updates here. Priya, flag customer acceptance; if they accept attestation we'll request AWS account details and KMS key ARN and proceed with peering. :thumbsup:
